simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to דָּאָה (H1676) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: דָּאָה (dâʼâh) means the kite (from its rapid flight) First listed occurrence: Lev 11 14.

definitions.full: H1676. daah דָּאָה noun feminine a bird of prey , possibly kite ( ᵑ9 Saad Bo Hieroz. ii. 191 Di Lev 11:14 ; Aramaic דַּיְתָא , ; Late Hebrew דַּיָּה of different birds of prey; name probably from flying, swooping), 11:14 forbidden as food; compare also Deut 14:13 והַדַּיָּה ואתהָֿאַיָּה וְהָרָאָה , where for הראה read הַדָּאָה & strike out הַדַּיָּה ; so ᵐ5 ⅏ ; compare Di l.c. ר Reš 20th letter; = 200 in post-Biblical Hebrew. רָאָה Deut 14:13 textual error; see דָּאָה
